bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
WT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.worktrees/search-colors-5a93de6"
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = 5a93de671ee158205759bb6e264cd3cd48466743
LOG="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$LOG"' EXIT
if docker build --network=host --progress=plain -f "$WT/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:search-color-5a93de6 "$WT" >"$LOG" 2>&1; then
 docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:search-color-5a93de6 >/dev/null
 exit 0
fi
python3 - "$LOG" <<'PY'
import pathlib,re,sys
s=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(errors='replace')
for code,pattern in [(111,'Cannot find matching keyid'),(113,'CERT_HAS_EXPIRED|certificate'),(119,'Internal Error: Error when performing the request'),(114,'ETIMEDOUT|ENOTFOUND|ECONNRESET'),(115,'403 Forbidden|429 Too Many Requests'),(84,'OUTDATED_LOCKFILE'),(86,'failed to calculate checksum'),(102,'pnpm install --frozen-lockfile'),(103,'build:gaybbs'),(104,'node --check')]:
 if re.search(pattern,s,re.I):sys.exit(code)
sys.exit(122)
PY
